_comment: Copy to parameters.json and fill in the customer's values. deploy.sh reads this. Region + profile are set as env vars (AWS_REGION / AWS_PROFILE), not here.
_subnets_comment: PrivateSubnetIds: 2 private subnets (2 AZs, EKS requirement) for nodes. PublicSubnetIds: 2+ public subnets in DIFFERENT AZs for internet-facing NLBs (required so worker targets in every node AZ are registered). Comma-separated, no spaces. If the customer truly has only one public subnet, pin workers to that AZ — see README 'Single public subnet'.
_secret_comment: cloudanix integration secret. SecretValue is a JSON object string of {workspace_id: token}. NoEcho in CF. Update later via aws secretsmanager put-secret-value.
